# `to_protobuf`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Converts a Catalyst binary input value into its corresponding
Protobuf format result.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
to_protobuf(child, messageName, descFilePath, options)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `protobuf_funcs` |
| Kind | unknown (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3, 4] |

## Examples

```sql
-- to_protobuf, example 1
> SELECT to_protobuf(s, 'Person', '/path/to/descriptor.desc', map('emitDefaultValues', 'true')) IS NULL FROM (SELECT NULL AS s);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```
